claim_checks.extract_quote: 100% impact for >30 lice, 50% impact for 10−30 lice, and no impact for 10 or fewer lice.

claim_checks.claim: PO3 area-wide RML: early migrants 32%, intermediate (May 15) 49%, late (June 5) 66%
claim_checks.extract_quote: RML for intermediate migrants was estimated to be 49%, while it was estimated to be 32% and 66% for early and late migrants, respectively, in PO3.
claim_checks.note: The extract provides these RML percentages for PO3.

claim_checks.claim: PO3 rivers: Oselvo RML 94/97/98% (early/int/late); Etne 0/17/68%; Oselvo RMT −30/−46/−56 d; Etne late only RMT −16 d
claim_checks.extract_quote: RML for sea trout from Oselvo was reduced by 94, 97 and 98% for early, intermediate and late migrants, respectively.
claim_checks.note: The extract provides these RML and RMT values for the rivers in PO3.

claim_checks.claim: PO5 area-wide RML: 34% early → 45% intermediate → 59% late
claim_checks.extract_quote: late RML was more negatively affected than early migrants in PO5, increasing from 34% for early migrants to 45 and 59% for intermediate and late migrants, respectively.
claim_checks.note: The extract provides these RML percentages for PO5.

claim_checks.extract_quote: Sea trout from Eira were much more dramatically affected by salmon lice regardless of migration timing, with 83, 87 and 85% RML for early, intermediate, and late migrants.
claim_checks.note: The extract provides these RML and RMT values for the rivers in PO5.

claim_checks.claim: Late migrants (June 5) always more affected than April 24 or May 15 across POs
claim_checks.extract_quote: Sea trout migrating to sea late (June 5) were always more affected by lice than those migrating early (April 24) or at intermediate dates (May 15).
claim_checks.note: The extract supports this claim about late migrants.

claim_checks.claim: Proposed TLS-style RML limits for sea trout: high >30%, moderate 10-30%, low <10% (parallel to salmon mortality bands)
claim_checks.extract_quote: One suggestion is to set the limit values to the same as the mortality limits used for Atlantic salmon (high impact: RML > 30%; moderate impact: 10% > RML < 30% and low impact: RML < 10%).
claim_checks.note: The extract discusses these proposed limits.
